changelog:
Fixes 0.3.3.9, which blurred the entire app.

WHAT HAPPENED

- 0.3.3.9 was meant to blur only the strip behind the bottom navigation
  bar. Instead it blurred every screen: lists, posters, titles, all of it.
  The app was unusable.
- The cause: the drawing surface used to blur the strip is shared with the
  one that draws everything else, so switching the blur on for the strip
  switched it on for the whole screen. Blurring one part of a screen needs
  two separate surfaces, not one used twice.

WHAT THIS BUILD DOES

- The blur is removed entirely. The bottom bar keeps the same translucent
  colour it had in 0.3.3.1 and earlier, and nothing else changes.
- Everything from 0.3.3.1 is still here: the press feedback, the
  poster-to-detail transition, the faster screen changes, and Appearance
  at the top of Settings with the pure black background and the seven
  accent colours.

WHY IT REACHED YOU

- The automated tests passed, because they photograph individual pieces
  like a channel row rather than a whole screen, and each piece was
  unchanged. I wrote down that I had not looked at it on a real screen,
  and then released it anyway. The blur does not come back until a
  screenshot of a real list shows a sharp list and a blurred strip.
